page.layout: One printed page: an engraved title page. Engraved architectural frame with figures and a globe; the central text panel carries the title lines, with a dark smudged bar across the middle; below, an oval cartouche with the imprint. Stamps and a manuscript shelf mark in the upper area are not transcribed.
page.notes: The central band of the title (between "PARTICULARIS" and "Quibus") is obliterated by a dark smudge; the words there are illegible. The date on the imprint is printed as cIↄ Iↄc XXI, i.e. MDCXXI. Handwritten shelf marks and library stamps at the top and bottom are omitted. The engraving itself (globe, allegorical figures, figures of learned men) is not transcribed as text.
